title: Phonetic trace effects in experimentally-induced vowel errors
token_or_recording_size: 5,683 vowel tokens before quality exclusions; 5,439 retained after laughter/formant-quality exclusions; 3,655 critical tokens plus 1,784 controls
annotation_target: vowel boundaries; F1/F2 midpoint; vowel duration; error labels
manual_scope: all MFA segmentations manually corrected; all Praat formant measurements hand-corrected against spectrograms
decision_reason: Primary controlled production experiment with exhaustive human correction of both segment boundaries and formant measurements and an explicit public OSF data deposit.
evidence_summary: Methods report 14 recruited American-English speakers with 12 analyzed; all audio was MFA-segmented then manually corrected, every Praat formant estimate was hand-corrected using a spectrogram-displaying Matlab tool, and the paper's data-availability statement deposits supporting data and analysis scripts at OSF DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/X8AKQ.
